gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-khudawa: Noto Sans Khudawadi keeps its capitals and lowercase close in height, with round shapes left unsealed. Metamorphous sits above it with a high midline and generous sidebearings.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-kr: Big, stately, and slightly strange. If Metamorphous were shrunk down, its wide sidebearings would lose their grandeur, while Noto Sans KR holds up at size with its large x-height and short ascenders.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-lao: Metamorphous has crossbars a touch thinner than its stems and a midline set high, which gives headings a distinct stance. Noto Sans Lao follows with a tall x-height and open mouths, so the text feels modern beneath it.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-lao-loo: Metamorphous moves with a gentle modulation that never snags the eye, and its sidebearings are generous. Then Noto Sans Lao Looped forms words into solid blocks, so paragraphs settle into a dense, steady texture.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Distinctive from the first glance, Metamorphous carries a high midline and moderately modulated strokes. Noto Sans Limbu answers underneath with tall-bodied small letters and curves that gape wide, a friendly counterweight.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Metamorphous glides through a smooth, modest weight gradient. Noto Sans Lisu runs underneath with tiny gaps below its ascender tops and wide s curves, so long text moves along quietly without any fuss.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Metamorphous brings medium-key contrast and a high-set midline, so it makes a heading feel commanding. Noto Sans Lydian does the quieter job, with capitals barely taller than its lowercase and wide, welcoming openings for the running text.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-mahajan: Noto Sans Mahajani reads tall and brisk, its lowercase standing well above the capitals and the e opening like a funnel. Metamorphous handles the showpiece work with its steady lettering-pen strokes, while this plain sans simply carries the words.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-malayal: Metamorphous has curves a little heavier than its joins, plus generous sidebearings that give it a ceremonial air. Noto Sans Malayalam keeps the middle zone dominant in each line, and its s opens generously, so text moves smoothly.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Noto Sans Mandaic lifts its lowercase close to capital height. Metamorphous is the one for commanding headings, with diagonals gently thinner than verticals, while the sans-serif text just keeps its curvy letters loose and legible.
